risk_coverage.source_assessment: tonic::codec::compression::{compress,decompress} allocate fresh stream::read Encoder/Decoder objects for each message. They do not borrow or reuse abandoned raw contexts. The new WebSocket raw decoder writes to an initialized fixed buffer and returns on decode error before exposing bytes. Neither changed path calls seekable decompression; this artifact is macOS arm64, not the affected wasm32 allocator. The write::Decoder/Vec uninitialized-memory advisory excludes read::Decoder.
